'''Saylor Marjan''' was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arapia]]. He was a longtime friend of [[Toob Ancher]].

==Biography==
Saylor was a friend of [[Toob Ancher]] until they had an argument and didn't speak to each other for about 20 [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. During those years, Saylor incurred a debt to [[Saadoon-Kauldi]], which was collected by Toob Ancher and [[Fahs Oxsor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Redcap]].<ref name="A Bitter Winter">{{JournalCite|5|A Bitter Winter}}</ref>
